# AP Regen Refresh Rate Calculator

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Oct 19, 2024
- 3 min read

Updated: May 21, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_b0ced96bd5a241fabad80ed92ef4e61e~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

With thanks to Thaang and Mario_will_die

__How to Use the AP Regen Refresh Rate Calculator__

**Base AP Refresh Rate:** This is set to 6 by default and represents your character's basic Action Points (AP) regeneration rate. You don’t need to change this value.

**Powered Legendary Armor Pieces:** Use the dropdown to select how many pieces of powered legendary armor your character is wearing (0 to 5). Each piece adds +5% AP regeneration.

**Kinetic Servos (Power Armor Legs):** Select how many Kinetic Servos you have equipped on your Power Armor legs (0 to 2). Each Servo adds +1% AP regeneration.

**Core Assembly (Power Armor Torso):** Choose whether you have the Core Assembly equipped (0 or 1). This adds +6% AP regeneration.

**Injector Rank:** Select the rank of your Injector perk. Higher ranks increase the AP regeneration of players you revive.

**Select Mutation:** Choose your character's mutation type from the dropdown (None, Herbivore, or Carnivore). This can affect AP regeneration.

**Strange in Numbers:** Check this box if you and your teammates have mutations. This perk enhances mutation effects when teammates are also mutated.

**Select Food/Drink:** Choose any food or drink that your character consumes from the dropdown. Each item has its own AP regeneration effect.

**Select Alcohol:** Select any alcoholic beverages your character consumes. Alcohol can significantly boost AP regeneration.

**Select Magazine:** Pick any magazine you are currently reading that provides AP regeneration bonuses.

**Vulcan Power Armour Pieces:** Use the dropdown to select how many Vulcan Power Armor pieces your character is wearing (0 to 6).

- **0-5 Pieces** : Each piece grants +0% AP regeneration.
- **6 Pieces** : If you select all 6 pieces, you’ll receive a +25% AP regeneration bonus as part of the Vulcan Power Armor set bonus.

**Action Boy/Girl Rank:** 

Choose your rank from the dropdown. This perk increases AP regeneration speed based on the selected rank:

- **Rank 1:** +15%
- **Rank 2:** +30%
- **Rank 3:** +45%

**Action Ghoul Rank:** 

Choose your rank from the dropdown. This perk increases AP regeneration speed based on the selected rank:

- **Rank 1:** +15%
- **Rank 2:** +30%
- **Rank 3:** +45%

**Packin' Light Rank:** 

Check this box if you are not over-encumbered. This perk increases AP regeneration speed by **+25%** when active.

**Nerd Rage Rank:** 

Select your rank. This perk activates when your health is low, providing additional AP regeneration bonuses:

- **Rank 1:** +15%
- **Rank 2:** +15%
- **Rank 3:** +15%

**Lone Wanderer Rank:** 

Choose your rank to enhance your AP regeneration when playing solo. This perk increases AP regen based on your Charisma. The higher your Charisma, the greater the bonus.

**Charisma (CHA):** 

Input your character’s Charisma score (0 to 100) to see how it affects AP regeneration. This affects the Lone Wanderer perk's AP bonus.

**Thirst Level**

Select your current Thirst Level from the dropdown. AP regeneration increases with higher thirst fullness when the Rejuvenated perk is active:

| **Thirst Level** | **Rank 1** | **Rank 2** | 
| None | No bonus applied | No bonus applied | 
| 0% to 20% | 0% | 0% | 
| 20% to 40% | +15% | +15% | 
| 40% to 60% | +15% | +15% | 
| 60% to 80% | +15% | +15% | 
| 80% and Above | +45% | +60% | 

**Well Tuned:** 

Check this box if your character is Well Tuned, as it provides an additional AP regeneration bonus:

- **Well Tuned:** +25% AP Regen

**Calculate AP Regen:** 

Once you've filled in all relevant fields, click the Calculate AP Regen button to see your total AP regeneration rate and how long it will take to refresh your AP to maximum.

**View Results:** 

The results will display:

- Total AP Regeneration Rate: Percentage of your AP restored per second.
- Time to Max AP: How many seconds it takes to fully restore your AP from 0 to 100%.
